ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Arbitrary Command Execution Using Msdt.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects processes leveraging the "ms-msdt" handler or the "msdt.exe" binary to execute arbitrary commands as seen in the follina (CVE-2022-30190) vulnerability

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\msdt\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "msdt\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*IT\\_BrowseForFile\\=.*") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ PCWDiagnostic.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-af\\ .*")))
